name: Catalog Avatar Creator
desc:
Catalog Avatar Creator allows you to try on many different avatar/catalog items for free. This includes accessories, hats, limiteds, hair combos, bundles, animation packs and more! You can also browse through an ever-growing collection of over 50M+ Community Created outfits, and save any avatars you have created in-experience! 

✅ All purchases made in-game will be available in your Roblox inventory & can be used in all games. 

✨ Join our Roblox Group here: https://www.roblox.com/groups/15102943 

🏆 Winner of the "Best Use of Fashion" Roblox Innovation Award (2023 and 2024)

llm.loop: browse the whole catalog -> try items on for free -> save or copy community outfits -> buy items straight to your inventory
llm.instructions: try on accessories, bundles, animations; browse 50M+ community outfits
mechanics: in-game purchases of real catalog items
unique: a shopping utility rather than a game; earns a commission on catalog sales
llm.thumbnails: UI screenshots of the avatar editor and item grid

video.loop_observed: Player searches the catalog for items (headphones, clothing, skateboards), tries them on their avatar, optionally buys them, sets photo backgrounds, plays emotes, and views or copies other players' outfits in a shared open space.
monetization_visible: TRY / BUY buttons on catalog items
Buy Item purchase prompt with Robux price
Send Robux option on player menu
video.session_depth: Promo-style trailer: early frames show catalog search and try-on of accessories and clothing; later frames show backgrounds, emotes, skateboard gear, and a player interaction menu (view/wear outfit, send Robux, add friend) with other players nearby, ending in a title card.
notable: core value is trying on any catalog item for free with a buy shortcut
player menu lets you view/wear others' outfits and send Robux
video is an edited ad with text overlays, not raw gameplay
